# Cycle19 equilibrium methods and constructive transfer

The strongest new service obtained in this cycle is a **conditional route sampler**. The hard-sphere BEC manuscript's uniform deterministic-opponent estimate gives a heat-bath contraction for its two-copy path factors. Given its exact base-factor and collision services and a fixed outside sample, n-factor routes can be sampled to ε TV accuracy using O(n log(n/ε)) local updates. Whole-route rejection is unnecessary. This improves a concrete conditional construction; the actual equilibrium outside marginal and continuous-path services remain unacquired.

## Sources and breadth

The assigned families260–272 were read at their overview/catalogue interfaces; all13 assessments are in `FAMILY_ASSESSMENT.json`. Two manuscripts were then read through every main-body proof at the pinned release commit `adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a`, dated6October2026:

* OpenAI, *Spontaneous magnetization in the quantum Heisenberg ferromagnet*, manuscript24September2026: all8 main-body sections.
* OpenAI, *Bose–Einstein condensation at positive temperature in the dilute hard-sphere gas*, manuscript5October2026: all10 main-body sections.

The release's model-produced manuscripts, catalogue claims and verification labels are author claims. Neither selected physical main theorem has an adopted formalization in this read. The Bloch-law and depletion companion papers are not read. The separate BEC history draft is not certified fully read. The full source-proof reconstruction is `notes/rounding_spectral/cycle19/FULL_SOURCE_PROOF_AUDIT.md`; recoverable selected release snapshots and39 source/read-scope records are in the owned source directory.

## 1. A sampler for the conditional two-copy route law

At a fixed outside configuration, whole shared-midpoint vertex factors are independent before same-copy collision conditioning. The exact target is ν_out ∝ J(out,ξ)∏F_i(dξ_i). Each factor has at most two checks against another factor. The source supplies deterministic-opponent collision probability e_D→0 and all-incident acceptance a=1−χ_D, uniformly against every individually permitted opponent assignment, even globally forbidden assignments.
